items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Canonical base-ui/base-nova button. forwardRef + useRender so Base UI triggers forward their anchor ref on React 18. Single source of truth for hooman-ui.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Canonical base-ui text input. forwardRef for react-hook-form on React 18. Uses .shadcn tokens (border/input/ring/foreground).

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Canonical base-ui badge with cva variants (default/secondary/destructive/success/warning/outline/ghost/link). Polymorphic via render. Uses .shadcn tokens.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty State
items.description: Empty state for tables, lists, and panels. Self-scoped to .shadcn (border/card/muted/ring tokens).
